export type AdminMessageKey = keyof typeof adminMessages.en

export function useAdminLocale() {
  const cookie = useCookie<Locale>('cfn_admin_locale', {
    // English by default — see the note above.
    default: () => 'en',
    maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 365,
    sameSite: 'lax',
    path: '/',
  })

  const locale = computed<Locale>(() => (cookie.value === 'km' ? 'km' : 'en'))

  function setLocale(next: Locale) {
    cookie.value = next
  }

  function t(key: AdminMessageKey, params?: Record<string, string | number>): string {
    let value: string = adminMessages[locale.value][key] ?? adminMessages.en[key] ?? key
    if (params) {
      for (const [name, replacement] of Object.entries(params)) {
        value = value.replace(`{${name}}`, String(replacement))
      }
    }
    return value
  }

  /** Editorial content stays in the language it was written in. */
  function contentTitle(item: { titleKh: string; titleEn?: string }): string {
    return locale.value === 'en' && item.titleEn ? item.titleEn : item.titleKh
  }

  return { locale, setLocale, t, contentTitle }
}
